sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation expansion for original hand-drawn 2D dark fantasy insect game. Reference images are identity and style references only, NOT desired grid or background. Preserve exact character identity, proportions, costume, palette, clean ink and painterly material textures. Pure side view all living frames facing RIGHT. Transparent real alpha background, no backdrop, ground, shadows, labels, text, borders, particles, panels. Each equal cell contains exactly one COMPLETE character including every antenna, blade and robe, with ample transparent gutter. Fixed body scale and centered pelvis, grounded foot baseline at 90% cell height. Distinct redrawn poses with real limb and weapon articulation, never stamp, shift or rotate a whole copy. Character: Hundred Key Gatekeeper exactly reference, towering ivory stag beetle sovereign with massive crescent ivory mandibles, elaborate antique key crown, black and silver segmented armor, white ermine collar, crimson silk royal cloak with gold edges, holding a long heavy brass KEY SCEPTER. Exactly 4 columns by 9 rows =36 full body sprites, tall canvas. Draw sprite SMALL at 60% cell width and height with 20% empty transparent margins EVERY SIDE. Never touch or overlap neighboring sprites, all full weapons must fit. Four frames each row: ROW1 idle breathing; ROW2 walk first four leg poses; ROW3 walk second four opposite leg poses; ROW4 windup lifting key scepter and bracing legs; ROW5 attack four rightward scepter swing/lunge poses; ROW6 recover four scepter retraction poses; ROW7 hurt four recoil/bent poses; ROW8 death stagger kneel fall collapsed; ROW9 extra two attack followthrough then two recover. Preserve identity same scale. No painted background or glow or floor or shadow. All side view facing right. Genuine transparent alpha.

qa.review: Source sheets visually reviewed; independent complete alpha components explicitly selected; merged characters and edge-clipped poses excluded. Source atlas and attacks unchanged.
qa.mechanical_packaging: Component isolation of authored source pixels, scale normalization and atlas packing; no procedural animation or interpolation.
